# Start Damage Over Time

Source: [wiki article 4446](../archive/4446.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Start Damage Over Time](../../api/actions/start-damage-over-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4446-n1"></a>

- DoT persists until its duration ends or a script stops it, using Last Damage Over Time ID for targeted cleanup.

<a id="wiki-4446-n2"></a>

- Null damager gives no credit; archive suggests a long duration such as 9999 for script-controlled expiry.
